brief:
Israeli settlers attacked Palestinian homes and assaulted residents in Halhul, north of Hebron, on Monday night while Israeli forces provided protection, Middle East Eye reported. The assault took place in the town located in the northern West Bank.

Local sources documented the incident, which resulted in injuries to several Palestinian residents during the coordinated assault on homes in the area.
